senses.gloss: m. pl. (v. קִיטְנִית) the beans of colocasia (ciborium).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 5:8">Maasr. V, 8</cite> <he>אף הק׳ פטורין וכ׳</he> Bab. ed. (Y. ed. <he>הקרטנים</he>; Mish. ed. <cite ref="S00302"><he>קוטנית</he></cite>) the colocasia beans are likewise exempt &c.; Tosef. ib. III, 14 <he>הקִיטִּין שלמטה וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>הקִנְטִּין</he>; oth. ed. <he>הקניטין</he>, corr. acc.) the beans beneath them (the colocasia leaves).
